What a morning!
A huge thank you to all the buyers and local organisations who made today’s Health & Social Care Meet the Buyer event such a success.
 - Real conversations.
 - Real opportunities.
 - Real connections across Bromley.

Great to see local VCSEs and SMEs directly engaging with organisations who can genuinely commission, procure and partner.
More to come…watch this space!!

comments.text: Super networking opportunity - Discussed successful Innovation Fund bids - More to come - and the resulting employment  opportunities for small commnity facing charities; mentoring support and services available for small charities; recycling IT equipement and putting the resource available for community usage. Well done Opportunity Bromley
Amazing event!! , thank you very much to the opportunity Bromley team  🙂
Thankyou for the opportunity to connect with others in Bromley
What a great event and we at Taking The Pixels had some lovely conversations with vendors. Some of which we are confident will turn into a business relationship 👊

Fantastic event @   Opportunity Bromley - I’d love to see this one run again in the future and more like it - so many good conversations that I just didn’t have enough time to speak to all the people on stands - love that Bromley is doing events like this 👏
We were delighted to attend and meet with so many committed and innovative businesses, CICs and charities
